Order Approving the Sale of Debtor's Real Property Pursuant to 11 U.S.C. 363 Together with Related Relief. The Application is granted to the extent set forth herein, and that the Court approves the conveyance of the Debtors interest in certain real property known as and by 8500 Naples Heritage Drive, Unit 1024, Naples, Florida, to Vincent and Jean Quigley, for the gross price of $430,000.00, subject to various adjustments as indicated in the Application, pursuant to Section 363(b) of the Bankruptcy Code. The Debtors application to retain Blue Heron Realty of Naples as the Debtor's real estate broker for the Sale and to pay such broker a sales commission in the amount of $21,500.00 is denied. The full sales commission of $21,500.00 that was paid to Blue Heron Realty of Naples at the closing of title shall be surcharged to the Debtors non-filing spouses share of the proceeds from the Sale. The Debtor is authorized to release the sum of $93,783.20 to Joan Ruggiero, the Debtors non-filing spouse, as her net distributive share of the proceeds from the Sale (Related Doc # 30) Signed on 11/4/2025. (dhc) (Entered: 11/04/2025)
